[b][size=5]Introduction﻿[/size][/b]

[i]"'Stay here, Hidan. Don't start cult stuff, Hidan. Don't threaten the locals, Hidan'. AND THEN he left. Just left me here like I'm some misbehaving pet."[/i]

After being defeated and presumed dead, Kakuzu and Hidan fled to Pelican Town to lay low and wait the war out. Kakuzu then leaves the town with the parting words: "I'll be back soon. Don't kill anyone."

As you build hearts with Hidan, he becomes increasingly vulnerable, chaotic, and affectionate. His story explores his loneliness and abandonment issues due to immortality; his strained (but deeply bonded) relationship with Kakuzu;  the weird process of learning to live in a peaceful town; and relying on someone who isn’t Kakuzu for the first time.

Keep him company as he (im)patiently waits for Kakuzu everyday without fail in the bus stop. Maybe one of these days the old miser will return?
Welcome to my very first Stardew Valley mod! I went absolutely balls-deep into modding with zero prior experience. This mod is messy, chaotic, coded at 3AM, and contains one (1) screaming immortal. I am actively updating it. Please report any sentience and I’ll spank Hidan so he will reflect on his behaviour.

[center]· · ─ ·✶· ─ · ·[/center]

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]

This mod adds Hidan and Kakuzu as fully custom, romanceable NPCs with:
- A custom tent in the Cindersap Forest
- Hundreds of lines of dialogue for all seasons, weather, heart levels, and locations (WIP)
- Heart events (up to 6 hearts for Hidan and up to 1 for Kakuzu, for a total of 15 events and counting)
- Unique daily schedule
- Unique gift tastes
